cohort: 38 patients at high risk of postpartum hemorrhage who underwent cesarean section
finding: Preventive B-Lynch suture during cesarean section in patients at high risk of postpartum hemorrhage appears effective and safe in the short term, avoiding hysterectomy in all cases and minimizing blood loss.
mod_finding: This study investigated the effectiveness of preventive B-Lynch suture during cesarean section in patients at high risk of postpartum hemorrhage and found it to be effective in avoiding hysterectomy and reducing postpartum bleeding.
